option_relations.rationale: Paroxysmal complete atrioventricular block is a specific type of AV block, which is distinct from Sick Sinus Syndrome, although both are cardiac conduction disorders.
Vagus-mediated paroxysmal atrioventricular block is a specific type of AV block with a vagal etiology, which is distinct from Sick Sinus Syndrome.
Neurally mediated (vasovagal) syncope is a cause of syncope, which can be related to bradyarrhythmias, but it is not equivalent to Sick Sinus Syndrome, which is a specific sinus node dysfunction.
Carotid sinus hypersensitivity is a cause of syncope due to an exaggerated reflex, which is distinct from Sick Sinus Syndrome.
